result.brief: 提出 UniRA，将表征对齐（REPA）与表征自编码器（RAE）统一为单一目标，使表征空间 tokenizer 同时作为扩散目标与对齐锚点，联合优化 tokenizer、扩散主干与外部表征模型，并给出权重平衡理论。
result.reason: Unifies REPA alignment with RAE representation-space tokenizer, co-optimizing tokenizer, DiT and external encoder; directly a RAE/generative latent-space and representation contribution.
